daju-kingdom.en: Indigenous dynasty preceding the Fur state, flourishing in the 13th–14th centuries by oral tradition (GHA5_CH7 p.187)
daju-kingdom.ar: أسرة محلية سبقت دولة الفور وازدهرت في القرنين الثالث عشر والرابع عشر بحسب الرواية الشفهية (GHA5_CH7 p.187) [يحتاج تحقق]

tunjur-kingdom.en: Succeeds the Daju in Darfur in the early 15th century; later driven out by the Fur (GHA5_CH7 pp.187–188)
tunjur-kingdom.ar: خلفوا الداجو في دارفور مطلع القرن الخامس عشر، ثم طردهم الفور لاحقاً (GHA5_CH7 pp.187–188) [يحتاج تحقق]

sultanate-of-darfur-keira.en: Fur dynasty from around Jabal Marra; Sulayman Solongdungu probably the founder; the Kayra sultanate flourished c.1640–1874, restored 1898, annexed 1916 (GHA V ch.7 p.187); O'Fahey (2008) dates it c.1650–1916 (page not confirmed) [VERIFY]

cite.cite_text: GHA V ch.7 p.189

sultanate-of-darfur-keira.en: Permanent capital grows at al-Fashir under 'Abd al-Rahman (d. 1801–2) (GHA V ch.7 pp.190–191)
sultanate-of-darfur-keira.ar: تثبيت العاصمة في الفاشر نحو 1790/1791 في عهد عبد الرحمن [يحتاج تحقق]

zagwe-dynasty.en: Christian kingdom of the Ethiopian highlands passes from the Zagwe to the Solomonid dynasty, 1270

wadai-sultanate.en: 'Abd al-Karim b. Jame (r.1611–55), who had studied in Borno, founds Wadai, probably with Borno's blessing (GHA5_BORNU_P493_513 p.511)
wadai-sultanate.ar: عبد الكريم بن جامع (حكم 1611–1655)، الذي تعلّم في برنو، يؤسس وداي، على الأرجح بمباركة برنو (GHA5_BORNU_P493_513 p.511) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: ''Abd al-Karîm b. Jame (r.1611-55), who studied in Borno, founded Wadai - no doubt with Borno's blessing'

wadai-sultanate.en: Mid-18th century: Sultan Muhammad Djawda of Wadai defeats an invading Fur army and captures the Fur sultan 'Umar Lei (GHA5_CH7 p.188)

cite.cite_text: 'After heavy fighting, the Sultan of Wadai, Muhammad Djawda, defeated the Für army and captured the sultan.'

wadai-sultanate.en: Darfur's Sultan Tayrab, failing to expand west, concludes a treaty with Wadai that holds for a hundred years (GHA5_CH7 p.189)

cite.cite_text: 'Having failed to expand westward against his formidable foe, the Sultan of Wadai, Tayrâb, concluded a treaty which remained effective for a hundred years.'

cite.cite_text: 'Wadai under Jawda (r. 1747-95) continued its expansionist policies towards Bahr al-Ghazäl.'

cite.cite_text: 'Wadai sultans, whose state had grown increasingly powerful after the mid-eighteenth century, were anxious to promote a route which bypassed Borno to the west and Dârfur to the east.'

garamantes-fezzan.en: Proconsul Cornelius Balbus raids the kingdom of the Garamantes of the Fezzan, 19 BC
garamantes-fezzan.ar: البروقنصل كورنيليوس بالبوس يغير على مملكة الجرمنت في فزان، 19 ق.م [يحتاج تحقق]

Line deleted (IM QA: undated event dropped at build).

sabaean-south-arabian-kingdoms.en: Mârib, capital of the kingdom of Saba: its principal temple on a tiered base parallels the temple of Yeha in Ethiopia
sabaean-south-arabian-kingdoms.ar: مأرب عاصمة مملكة سبأ: معبدها الرئيسي القائم على قاعدة مدرّجة يناظر معبد يحا في إثيوبيا [يحتاج تحقق]

rise-of-islam-caliphates.date_note: GHA III ch.19 p.560 prints "In about 615"; emigration also at GHA III ch.2 p.35.

suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.ar: ميناء ولاية الحبش العثمانية منذ القرن السادس عشر

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.ar: أسسها عبد الله جمّاع (من رفاعة) عند ملتقى النيلين الأزرق والأبيض أواخر القرن الخامس عشر [يحتاج تحقق]

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.en: Prospered from tolls on desert nomads
abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.ar: ازدهرت من المكوس المفروضة على رحّل البادية

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.en: Recognised by Funj sultans as paramount chiefs of the Arabs
abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.ar: اعترف بهم سلاطين الفونج شيوخاً أعلى للعرب [يحتاج تحقق]

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.en: Capital Qarri, later Halfayat al-Muluk; an 'Abdallabi chief ruled Quz Rajab on the Atbara
abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.ar: العاصمة قرّي ثم حلفاية الملوك؛ وحكم شيخ عبدلابي قوز رجب على نهر عطبرة [يحتاج تحقق]

ja-aliyyin-kingdom-sa-dab-funj-vassal.en: Tribal kingdom between the Atbara confluence and the Sabaluqa Gorge from the 16th c.
ja-aliyyin-kingdom-sa-dab-funj-vassal.ar: مملكة قبلية بين ملتقى عطبرة وخانق السبلوقة منذ القرن السادس عشر

ja-aliyyin-kingdom-sa-dab-funj-vassal.en: Royal clan the Sa'dab; Mirafab kingdom at Berber to the north
ja-aliyyin-kingdom-sa-dab-funj-vassal.ar: العشيرة الملكية السعداب؛ ومملكة الميرفاب في بربر شمالاً [يحتاج تحقق]

ja-aliyyin-kingdom-sa-dab-funj-vassal.en: Shendi became the chief commercial centre of the eastern Bilad al-Sudan by early 19th c., under Makk Nimr
ja-aliyyin-kingdom-sa-dab-funj-vassal.ar: أصبحت شندي المركز التجاري الرئيسي لبلاد السودان الشرقي بحلول مطلع القرن التاسع عشر في عهد المك نمر [يحتاج تحقق]

musabba-at-sultanate-kordofan.en: Exiled Keira faction contesting Kordofan with Funj and Darfur, late 17th–18th c.
musabba-at-sultanate-kordofan.ar: فرع منفي من الكيرا نازع الفونج ودارفور على كردفان، أواخر القرن السابع عشر–القرن الثامن عشر

cite.cite_text: 'the Musabba'ät, who must have regained power in Kordofan after the withdrawal of Abu Likaylik in 1761-2' (p.189)

musabba-at-sultanate-kordofan.date_note: GHA V p.189: the Musabba'at 'must have regained power in Kordofan after the withdrawal of Abu Likaylik in 1761-2'; year = end of that range, approximate (the late 17th c. start is not dated in print)
